feature_definitions.description_present: Existing structural blank/null missingness; presence is not verified completeness
feature_definitions.category_present: Retailer ProductCategory supplied and nonmissing; no inferred hierarchy rule
feature_definitions.brand_seen: Normalized ProductBrand occurs in this target's approved labeled training records
feature_definitions.brand_training_groups: Distinct frozen groups containing that normalized key in this target's labeled training
feature_definitions.brand_key_unambiguous: Training key has exactly one observed target label; not a taxonomy assertion
feature_definitions.common_class: Predicted class has at least 1000 approved labeled training rows
feature_definitions.class_whitelist: Class screen learned only from the old calibration-fit subset; no true label required at arrival

confidence_ranges: Diagnostics only; no confidence threshold or score variant changes
selection: Maximum coverage with search-adjusted beta >=.99; else nominal >=.99; else best lower bound among sufficiently large observed-99% improvements; never audit fallback
evidence_status: Historical development exploration; role separation does not undo previous exposure
